english.title: Run aircraft engine at Manchester Airport above idling speed for tests outside specified hours
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or the permission of the Airport Company first having been obtained, ran the engine of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), above its idling speed for start up for test purposes inside an engine test bay or other such area within Manchester Airport allocated for that purpose outside the hours allocated for that purpose by the Company
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2.2 and 4.1.3 of the Manchester Airport PLC Byelaws 2024.
